card.name: Inside foreign proper names
card.fires_on: Partway through transliterated place names, personal names and foreign terms, often Indian, Hungarian or Ethiopian. It fires on the syllable in the middle of the name, such as ah in Rajahmundry or ara in Metahara.

modes.label: Indian place names
modes.description: Middle syllable of a long Indian place or temple name.

modes.label: Other foreign names
modes.description: Accented or non-English syllables inside Hungarian, Ethiopian or Irish names.

modes.label: Sanskrit and scripture terms
modes.description: Syllable inside a Sanskrit text name or abbreviation.

card.plain: It fires in the middle of unfamiliar foreign names, mostly Indian place and text names.
